title: UI polish: art-direction style test and layout mockups (design only)
problem: The table shows too much at once, repeats numbers, wastes width on rival stalls and has no single focus per phase; the visual system is inconsistent. The owner's priorities: clutter, lack of animation and feel, and the art style itself; reference: It Takes Two (qualities only, no assets).
scope: Style test: the same buying screen in three directions (A polished pixel, B toy-box tabletop, C 3D-diorama flat render) plus one fruit in four freshness stages, one customer and one rival in direction B, viewable on a phone
Layout mockups in the chosen direction for buy, price, reveal, evening and home: one top bar, slim rival stalls, plain-language demand, one focus per phase
Motion notes and a short animated example of the reveal flip
All art original; reference games are inspiration only
exclusions: Building the chosen design (a separate plan after the owner picks)

acceptance.text: Phone-viewable page with the style test (3 directions on one screen) and 5 mockup screens
Every idea linked to a REP-014 problem or a REP-015 quality
